declarations.description: Calculator toggle button for an item header inside `<pie-item-scope>`. It opens and closes the calculator the item toolbar renders, through the toolkit coordinator's tool requests, and reflects that calculator's visibility in `aria-pressed`; `target-tool-id` points it at another toolbar's calculator. It stays disabled until the runtime context supplies a tool coordinator and the target toolbar renders a calculator.
declarations.name: ToolCalculatorInline
